name: gpt-large
prompt: Enhance this low-light photo: reduce noise and correct the exposure while keeping it a natural night scene. Preserve every detail exactly as it is: all text and lettering, faces, geometry and the colours of the light sources. Do not add, remove or change any content.

size_rule.description: large: ≤ 8,294,400 px (OpenAI's documented maximum; experimental above 2560×1440), owner decision 2026-10-31
size_rule.algorithm: largest short edge (multiple of 16) whose aspect-rounded long edge fits; no cropping

retry.note: owner decision 2026-10-31: at most one retry per logical slot (two attempts), transient technical failures only; urllib makes no hidden retries

cost_bound.basis: No published GPT Image 2.5 token formula exists (OpenAI image-generation guide, read 2026-10-31: 'use the response's usage to measure token consumption'). Bound from the spike's measured usage (research.md § Empirical half): output 2,223 image tokens at 3.15 MP and 2,127 at 3.54 MP, i.e. ≤ 706 tokens/MP; bounded at 1,500 tokens/MP (> 2× the measured density). Input 1,452 and 1,504 image tokens for 12 MP and 17.7 MP inputs; bounded at 3,000. Prompt 71 text tokens; bounded at 200 at $10/M (above any listed text-input rate). Rates $30/M output image, $8/M input image (OpenAI pricing, read 2026-10-29). Plus $0.01 per call for billing rounding; the total is rounded up to the cent. A response whose usage exceeds the bound stops the runner.
